definitions.explanation: An electrical kitchen appliance designed to cook rice automatically.

examples.japanese: {炊飯器|すいはんき}でご{飯|はん}を{炊|た}く。
examples.english: Cook rice in a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: この{炊飯器|すいはんき}は{三合|さんごう}{炊|だ}きです。
examples.english: This rice cooker is a 3-cup model.
examples.notes: {合|ごう} is the traditional unit for measuring rice

examples.japanese: {炊飯器|すいはんき}の{保温|ほおん}{機能|きのう}は{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: The keep-warm function of rice cookers is convenient.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{炊飯器|すいはんき}を{買|か}ったら、ご{飯|はん}がとても{美味|おい}しくなった。
examples.english: After buying a new rice cooker, the rice became much more delicious.

examples.japanese: うちの{炊飯器|すいはんき}は{予約|よやく}{機能|きのう}がついているので、{朝|あさ}{起|お}きたらすぐに{炊|た}きたてのご{飯|はん}が{食|た}べられます。
examples.english: Our rice cooker has a timer function, so we can have freshly cooked rice as soon as we wake up in the morning.

notes:
An essential appliance in Japanese households. Types:
- マイコン{式|しき} (microcomputer-controlled) - basic, affordable
- IH{式|しき} (induction heating) - even heating, better quality
- {圧力|あつりょく}IH{式|しき} (pressure IH) - premium, fluffier rice
- {土鍋|どなべ}IH (clay pot IH) - mimics traditional cooking

Features:
- {保温|ほおん} (keep warm)
- {予約|よやく}{炊飯|すいはん} (timer/scheduled cooking)
- {早炊|はやだ}き (quick cook)
- {玄米|げんまい}モード (brown rice mode)
- おかゆモード (porridge mode)

Major Japanese brands: 象印 (Zojirushi), タイガー (Tiger), パナソニック (Panasonic), 日立 (Hitachi), 三菱 (Mitsubishi).

Capacity measured in {合|ごう}: {三合炊|さんごうだ}き (3 cups), {五合炊|ごごうだ}き (5 cups), etc.
